en.sarwar: 18. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja’far who has said the following:

“I once wrote to abu Muhammad, Alayhi al-Salam, and asked, ‘A woman has breastfed the son of a man; if the man can marry the daughter of breastfeeding woman. He (the Imam) signed the answer, ‘No, he cannot marry because it is not lawful for him.’”
